column1: # Components copied from pinned upstream images, for scripts/collect-legal.sh.
#   component, Dockerfile stage, license (SPDX), version command,
#   upstream license files ("<owner/repo> <tag> <file>...", {version} substituted, - if the
#     image ships them): fetched into /legal/attribution/<component>/ at the installed version,
#   purl ({version} substituted, - if none) for tools SBOM scanners can't identify on their
#     own: added to /legal/sbom/devcontainer.cdx.json, hashed from the first installed path.
# The "base" stage lists files Ubuntu's base image ships outside any apt package.
# Adding a COPY'd tool to the Dockerfile requires a row here.
